Implement evaluate(request, policy). Start with policy.defaults and apply layers in order. Unknown keys fail with unknown_key. Null resets to defaults only when policy.null_resets is true. Environment overrides require policy.environment and known keys. Parse boolean only from exact true/false strings. Integer environment strings contain decimal digits with an optional leading minus, with no spaces, plus sign, decimal point, or exponent. Invalid boolean/integer environment values fail with environment. String environment values are copied unchanged. Check all value types only after all layers and environment overrides. Enforce exact policy types; booleans are not integers. Type failures use type. Return {ok, config, error}; failures have empty config, successes have null error. Preserve explicit false, zero, and empty strings.
